newsitem.title: USA: Lexington Cty, S.C., to vote on school bonds.
newsitem.headline: Lexington Cty, S.C., to vote on school bonds.

text.p: South Carolina's Lexington County School District 1 has agreed to put a $61 million general obligation bond issue on the May 3 ballot, a school spokeswoman said Wednesday.
The proposal was approved by the school board Tuesday night and probably will not require a tax increase, spokeswoman Janice Buff said.
"We do have some debt service that is about to be retired and they don't feel it will increase taxes. If it does the amount will be very insignificant," Buff said.
The district, which covers the Lexington, Gilbert and Pelion areas of metropolitan Columbia, has 14,400 students.
